title: GTA 6 The Album Rumored for November 19th Release
description: A massive leak on Reddit suggests Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album featuring 34 original tracks and major artists launches November 19th (Unconfirmed).
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 The Album Leak Points to November 19th Release with Star-Studded Lineup

Recent discussions on the Reddit r/GTA6 community have brought to light a major piece of news regarding the musical landscape of *Grand Theft Auto VI*. According to community user /u/PapaXan, *Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album*—a collection featuring 34 brand-new, original tracks from a genre-defying roster of top-tier artists—is reportedly available for pre-save now on all major music streaming services. 

Please note that as this information originates from a community/rumor source, it remains unconfirmed by Rockstar Games at this time.

### An Eclectic and Star-Studded Tracklist

The rumored album boasts an impressive lineup spanning various musical styles, emphasizing the eclectic and culturally diverse curation that fans have come to expect from the franchise. Alongside the announcement of the 34-track collection, six debut singles have been made available for early listening:

- **Yung Lean** - *That's It* (feat. Future & Metro Boomin)
- **Travis Scott** - *RHYNO* (prod. by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo)
- **CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Etienne de Crécy** - *Sexy Magic*
- **Morgan Wallen** - *Last Thing You Need*
- **Rauw Alejandro** - *Macacoa 2000*
- **Keith Richards** - *Bright Lights, Big City*

### The Importance of Music in the GTA Universe

Music has always been the heartbeat of the Grand Theft Auto series, acting as a crucial anchor for immersion and setting the distinct tone of the game's open-world setting. Industry analysis suggests that a dedicated original album of this scale could represent a massive push by Rockstar Games to blend top-tier real-world music production directly into the fabric of the upcoming title's ecosystem.

While the community is buzzing over the November 19th launch window and the impressive artist collaborations, players should treat these details with cautious optimism until official announcements are made by Rockstar.

### Editor's Take

Music is the ultimate soul of the GTA franchise. If this community-sourced leak holds any truth, the sheer star power and genre-bending diversity of this album prove that Rockstar is aiming to redefine gaming soundtracks once again. We will keep a close eye on official channels for any updates.
